4th Period.workingNow: Finding the file your mechanic lives in, and building the smallest version of it that runs.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: week06-mod-design.md in your Mario repo — your full MDA design (Mechanics, Dynamics, Aesthetics) for your mod, plus a state map of the one mechanic you build first — committed by Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can find the right file in the base game and change one thing so that I can start building my mod instead of only planning it.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.12 — Design and iteratively develop programs that combine control structures, including nested loops and compound conditionals.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.3 — Offering and supporting opinions and negotiating with others in communicative exchanges.
agenda: Quick overview: find your file (3 min)
I do: tour the base game's files (12 min)
We do: change one number and watch it (8 min)
You do: build the smallest version of your mechanic (22 min)
Exit Ticket: which file did you edit? (3 min)
4th Period.connections: You have a design and a state map. Today you open the actual code and find where your mechanic belongs — config, player, draw, or level. Smallest version first: one number, one line. Tomorrow you write the whole thing up and push it.

6th Period.workingNow: Adding your fourth and fifth states, then checking that every state has a way in and a way out.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A finished state machine diagram for one thing you choose — at least 5 states, every state with a labeled way in and a labeled way out — partner-tested and turned in by Sunday night.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can check my diagram for dead ends so that my thing can never get stuck in a state it cannot leave.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.17 — Systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.3 — Offering and supporting opinions and negotiating with others in communicative exchanges.
agenda: Quick overview: today you get to five (2 min)
I do: the vending machine, five states (12 min)
We do: find the dead end in my diagram (8 min)
You do: add states 4 and 5, hunt dead ends (22 min)
Exit Ticket: one state you added (3 min)
6th Period.connections: You have three states that go in a circle. Today you add two more and learn the one mistake that breaks every state machine: a state you can get into and never get out of. Tomorrow a partner tries to get your machine stuck.
